subject: Yeah quite a few
author: Nath360skillz
body:
One of my favourite spots to park in is..how do i describe it...

near south bay expressway bridge, go towards harbour town and take the right hand shortcut follow it, jump off the end then keep right and go slowly through the bilboard then just sit on the box thingy behind it. U could also leave ur car on a hard to reach roof where people cant really be bothered to go to in freeburn such as opposite angus wharf garage. Never leave ur car parked on the ground unless u dont mind bein taken down. Another one i like is in downtown, jump off the mall after jumping off the train track then jump to the right afterwards and sit on that rooftop.
